Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: we covered use cases (conversational support + insights embedding), expected scale (~2M tokens/month to start), and latency SLOs for customer-facing features. Acme's procurement questions were near the finish line; I wanted to confirm the commercial path so we can unblock legal/procurement on both sides.

Immediate items we discussed:
- Procurement route: PO (net 30) vs. corporate card — which is your preference?
- Vendor setup packet: can you share your vendor intake form and any required tax or banking documents?
- Marketplace: would you prefer to purchase via AWS Marketplace (metered) or direct contract?
- Redlines: finance/legal would like to see any material contract questions early so we can coordinate on the MSA/SOW.

I attached a short Redwood vendor info sheet (what you need from us) to help your procurement team.

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_info.pdf

If you can send the vendor packet and indicate PO vs card by EOD Thursday, I’ll loop in Rishi (billing) to prepare the PO terms.

Best,

Subject: Re: Procurement intake and next steps for Redwood evaluation

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. We had a quick internal sync with procurement and finance; a few items below and I’ve attached our vendor setup packet.

Questions / notes:
1) We prefer to pay by PO on net-30 terms for new SaaS vendors. Our procurement team will submit a PO once vendor setup is complete.
2) Required documents: vendor setup packet (attached), W-9 or W-8 (depending on tax status), bank details for ACH. We included fields for: legal name, EIN, remit address, bank routing/account, and primary billing contact.
3) Contract: we typically accept our Master Services Agreement (we’ll share redlines if any), but happy to sign a Redwood MSA as well.
4) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred for some cost centers, but Marketplace procurement can take longer. For speed, PO direct to vendor is usually faster.

Attached: ACME_vendor_setup_packet.pdf

Can you return your completed W-9 and bank form to vendor-portal@acme-analytics.com and copy me? Once we have those we’ll issue a PO. Last question: what legal name and EIN should we put on the PO?

Thanks —
Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics
